title: Backing Up Important Files
paragraphs: Setelah laptopnya tiba-tiba berhenti berfungsi suatu pagi, Wahyu sempat panik, menyadari bahwa berbulan-bulan dokumen kerja penting mungkin hilang secara permanen tanpa salinan lain yang tersimpan di tempat mana pun.

Seorang teknisi akhirnya berhasil memulihkan sebagian besar filenya, tapi jam-jam penuh ketidakpastian yang menegangkan itu meyakinkan Wahyu untuk akhirnya mengatur cadangan otomatis di cloud, sesuatu yang telah ia tunda lebih dari setahun.
Mengaturnya hanya memakan waktu sekitar lima belas menit, jauh lebih sedikit usaha dari yang awalnya ia kira, dan kini filenya tersimpan otomatis setiap kali ia mengubah dokumen penting apa pun.

Beberapa bulan kemudian, ketika laptopnya dicuri dari mobilnya, Wahyu merasa jauh lebih tenang dari yang diperkirakan, karena ia tahu setiap file penting sudah tersimpan aman di tempat lain secara daring.
answerKey: After his laptop suddenly stops working one morning, Wahyu panics briefly, realizing that months of important work documents might be permanently lost with no other copy saved anywhere else. A technician later manages to recover most of his files, but the stressful hours of uncertainty convince Wahyu to finally set up automatic cloud backup, something he had been postponing for over a year. Setting it up takes only about fifteen minutes, far less effort than he had originally assumed, and now his files save automatically every time he makes a change to any important document. A few months later, when his laptop is stolen from his car, Wahyu feels far calmer than expected, since he knows every important file is already safely stored elsewhere online.
